claims.text: For a bigrassmannian \(v\), with \(i,j,a,b\) as specified, \(J_v\subset\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) is minimally generated by \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]

The minimal homogeneous generating family above has degree-enumerator \[ \sum_{\mu}q^{|\mu|} =q^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}q^{|\rho|} =q^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_q. \] Consequently it has exactly \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements, with exactly \([q^k]\binom{a+b}{a}_q\) generators in partition-weight degree \(ij+k\).
The formula includes \(a=0\): the family is the singleton \(\{\bar s_{i^j}\}\), and its enumerator is \(q^{ij}\).
